### A Young King’s Folly
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/young-kings-folly
Passage: 1 Kings 12:14
Points:
- Rehoboam faced an immediate leadership test when the people asked him to lighten the burden of Solomon's forced labor.
- Instead of following the wise counsel of the elders, he adopted the harsh advice of his younger peers.
- His oppressive response alienated the people and triggered a widespread rebellion that split the nation.
- The fracturing of the kingdom fulfilled prophetic scripture through the concurrence of human decisions and God's providence.
- Even though God uses human actions to achieve His purposes, individuals remain entirely accountable for their foolish choices.
